record.bible_text: And he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto me, Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, stand<WH05975><WTH8798> upon thy feet<WH07272>, and I will speak<WH01696><WTH8762> unto thee.

But thou, son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> what I say<WH01696><WTH8764> unto thee; Be not<WH01961><WTH8799> thou rebellious<WH04805> like that rebellious<WH04805> house<WH01004>: open<WH06475><WTH8798> thy mouth<WH06310>, and eat<WH0398><WTH8798> that I give<WH05414><WTH8802> thee.
